用兼容手柄的触摸板模拟鼠标移动。: Use a compatible controller touchpad to move the mouse.

针对超过 10 个核心的处理器相关崩溃。无此问题时可保持关闭。: Address crashes associated with CPUs having more than 10 cores. Leave off if unaffected.
允许 Windows 将主线程和渲染线程分配到不同核心，不再都固定于第一个核心。: Allow Windows to schedule the main and render threads on different cores instead of pinning both to the first core.
让垂直同步使用所选刷新率，避免锁定在 30 FPS。: Make VSync use the selected refresh rate instead of limiting the game to 30 FPS.
改善垂直同步限帧的帧间隔，并减少限帧等待时持续占用处理器。: Improve VSync frame pacing and reduce CPU busy-waiting while limiting the frame rate.
修正存档的难度通关记录，使 Hardcore 与 Zealot 奖励正常解锁。: Correct difficulty completion records so Hardcore and Zealot rewards unlock correctly.
修正装备编号冲突，减轻购买特定服装后其他服装消失的问题。: Fix equipment ID conflicts that can make other suits disappear after purchasing certain suits.
修正商店中 Hazard 工程服错误显示精英高级服头盔的问题。: Correct the Hazard engineering suit store icon, which can display the Elite Advanced Suit helmet.
修正存档字符串处理中的缓冲区越界。对游戏版本的函数匹配有要求，默认关闭。: Fix a buffer overrun in save string handling. Requires matching game functions; off by default.
减轻自动武器在不同帧率下射速不一致的问题。: Reduce frame-rate-dependent changes to automatic weapon fire rates.
修正高于 30 FPS 时重载检查点导致太阳能阵列电梯门卡住的问题。: Fix the Solar Array elevator door getting stuck after reloading a checkpoint above 30 FPS.
修正高于 720p 时景深、泛光、发光与热浪效果的模糊强度。: Correct depth-of-field, bloom, glow and heat-haze blur above 720p.
修正部分着色器误读法线所导致的玻璃反射、手电、粒子照明与动态模糊异常。: Fix shaders misreading normals, affecting glass reflections, the flashlight, particle lighting and motion blur.
修复 NVIDIA 显卡开启耀斑时出现的块状光影异常。该修复使用 Direct3: Fix block-shaped lens-flare artifacts on NVIDIA GPUs. Uses the Direct3D9 hook path.
减轻高于 30 FPS 时头发与布料变轻、漂浮的现象。: Reduce weightless or floating hair and cloth above 30 FPS.
减轻高帧率下菜单滚动、菜单镜头跟随鼠标过快的问题。: Reduce overly fast menu scrolling and mouse-following menu camera movement at high frame rates.
减轻不限帧时游戏时间快于真实时间，以及帧间隔不稳定的问题。: Reduce accelerated game time and unstable frame pacing when the frame rate is uncapped.
让主线程等待音频时休眠，减少持续空转占用处理器。: Let the main thread sleep while waiting for audio to reduce CPU busy-waiting.
按真实帧时间处理下一地区的数据，减轻高帧率时的流送卡顿。: Process upcoming areas using real frame time to reduce streaming stutter at high frame rates.
缩短区域音频加载时产生的停顿。: Reduce stalls when loading area audio.
在场景流送期间上传新纹理，减轻首次显示新纹理时的卡顿。: Upload new textures during streaming to reduce stutter when they first become visible.
减轻高帧率下边移动边转向时角色短暂停顿的问题。: Reduce brief movement hitches when moving and turning at high frame rates.
修正高帧率下钉刺弹体力度不足、敌人未能钉在墙上的表现。: Correct weak impaling projectiles that fail to pin enemies to walls at high frame rates.
让持续爆炸按预期频率计算伤害与推力，避免高帧率时每帧重复命中。: Apply continuous explosion damage and force at the intended rate instead of on every high-frame-rate frame.
修正高帧率下身后火焰、蒸汽、火花与爆炸过早停止的问题。: Prevent off-screen fire, steam, sparks and explosions from ending too early at high frame rates.
修正载入更快时换装柜门过早打开，与灯光扫过不同步的问题。: Fix suit kiosk doors opening too early and out of sync with the lighting sweep when loading is faster.
显示成就进度、解锁提示和成就列表。默认使用 HOME 键打开列表。: Show achievement progress, unlock notifications and an achievement list. HOME opens the list by default.
阻止连接已经失效的在线服务，并隐藏相关断线提示。: Block connections to unavailable online services and hide related disconnection messages.
让当前区域保留更多尸体与断肢；数量可在参数页调整，可能增加资源占用。: Keep more bodies and limbs in the current area. Counts are adjustable in Parameters and may use more resources.
允许保留更详细的贴花效果，可能增加资源占用。: Retain more detailed decal effects, potentially increasing resource use.
启动游戏时跳过开场视频。: Skip intro videos when launching the game.
数据实际加载完成后立即结束加载画面，不再等待人为设定的最短时长。: End the loading screen as soon as data is ready instead of waiting for an artificial minimum duration.

从 mods 子目录载入替换资源，目录结构需与资源导出结构一致。: Load replacement assets from mods, following the exported asset directory structure.
配合散装模组使用，跳过只包含已替换资源的归档区段；首次载入会建立资源映射记录。: For loose-file mods, skip archive sections containing only replaced assets. An asset map is created on first load.
改善斜视角纹理清晰度；0 表示关闭。: Improve texture clarity at oblique angles. 0 disables it.
只在游戏阴影设为“非常高”时使用；高于 1920 才启用覆盖。: Used only with in-game shadows set to Very High. Values above 1920 enable the override.
FXAA、SMAA 需要游戏内抗锯齿开启；SSAA 更清晰，但性能开销较大。: FXAA and SMAA require in-game anti-aliasing. SSAA is sharper but more demanding.
仅使用 SSAA 时生效，倍率越高，显卡负担越重。: Applies only to SSAA. Higher values increase GPU load.
以默认视野为基准，1.0 为原始视野。: Relative to the default field of view. 1.0 is the original value.

数值越高越平滑，但响应也会变慢。: Higher values smooth movement but make it less responsive.
